english: The plan folded in and soft-deleted.
translation: 将被并入并软删除的计划。

english: Optional; recorded in the merge history.

translation: 两个计划 ID 均为必填。

english: The surviving and duplicate plans must differ.
translation: 保留计划与重复计划必须不同。

english: Merge {dup} into {main}? The duplicate is soft-deleted.
translation: 确定将 {dup} 合并到 {main} 吗？重复计划将被软删除。

english: Could not copy — copy it from the address bar
translation: 无法复制 — 请从地址栏复制
来自 authentication-service（魔法链接登录）。
没有超过匹配阈值的项。

english: Your session has ended. What you typed is still here: sign in again in a new tab, then save.
translation: 您的会话已结束。您输入的内容仍在此处：请在新标签页中重新登录，然后保存。

english: Sign in again (opens a new tab)
translation: 重新登录（在新标签页中打开）

english: You have changes that are not saved. Leave this page anyway?
translation: 您有未保存的更改。仍要离开此页面吗？

english: No open ideas — capture one above.
translation: 暂无开放想法 — 请在上方记录。

english: Map items to objectives from each item's governance panel.
translation: 请在各工作项的治理面板中将其关联到目标。

english: No allocations yet — add them on an item's governance panel.
translation: 暂无分配 — 请在工作项的治理面板中添加。

english: Schedules are drawn per portfolio umbrella.
translation: 进度表按伞形组合绘制。

english: A magic link sent to your email: no password to leak or reuse.
translation: 魔法链接发送到你的邮箱：没有密码可泄露或重复使用。

english: Fine-grained rules decide who may read, write, merge or delete.
translation: 细粒度规则决定谁可以读取、写入、合并或删除。

english: An append-only history records every change and who made it.
translation: 仅追加的历史记录会记下每一次更改及操作者。

english: Sensitive details are masked unless you are entitled to see them.
translation: 除非你有权查看，否则敏感信息会被屏蔽。

english: REST with OpenAPI, and HL7 FHIR where health systems need it.
translation: REST 搭配 OpenAPI，并在医疗系统需要时支持 HL7 FHIR。

english: Arabic, Chinese, English, French, German, Hindi, Spanish and Welsh.
translation: 阿拉伯语、中文、德语、英语、法语、印地语、西班牙语和威尔士语。

english: Sign in with a magic link sent to your email. No password needed.
translation: 通过发送到邮箱的魔法链接登录，无需密码。
每项计划，一个互联视图

english: Manage portfolios, projects, and products in one recursive plan tree, from first idea to delivery, with governance, schedules, and an audit trail built in.
translation: 在一棵递归的计划树中管理组合、项目和产品，从最初的想法到交付，并内置治理、进度计划和审计记录。

english: Every plan can contain any other, from a whole portfolio down to a single task.
translation: 任何计划都可以包含其他计划，从整个组合到单个任务。

english: Dashboards roll up stage, risk, and budget status across every plan.
translation: 仪表板汇总所有计划的阶段、风险和预算状态。

english: Matching flags a likely duplicate plan as it is created, and merging keeps one.
translation: 创建时匹配会标出疑似重复的计划，合并后只保留一份。

english: Executive, finance, and technology views show what needs attention now.
translation: 管理层、财务和技术视图显示当前需要关注的事项。

english: Kanban boards and burndown charts show real progress, not wishful status.
translation: 看板和燃尽图展示真实进展，而非一厢情愿的状态。

english: Ideas become proposals, then plans, through a pipeline everyone can see.
translation: 想法经过人人可见的流程，变成提案，再变成计划。

english: An optional kind label and a parent link, with roll-ups through every level.
translation: 可选的类型标签和父级链接，并逐层汇总。

english: A Kanban board, sprints, and an honest burndown for each plan.
translation: 每项计划都有看板、冲刺和真实的燃尽图。

english: Stage gates, risks, budget lines, benefits, and milestones in one panel.
translation: 阶段关口、风险、预算项、效益和里程碑集于一个面板。

english: Dated child plans, dependencies, and the critical path on a Gantt chart.
translation: 在甘特图上查看带日期的子计划、依赖关系和关键路径。

english: Capture ideas, vote on proposals, and compare what-if portfolios.
translation: 收集想法，对提案投票，并比较假设情景下的组合。

english: Align plans to OKRs and see per-person load, with over-allocation flagged.
translation: 将计划与 OKR 对齐，查看每个人的负载，并标出超额分配。

english: You need an account to work with real data. Signing in takes under a minute and needs no password.
translation: 处理真实数据需要账号。登录不到一分钟，也不需要密码。

english: Choose Sign in at the top right and enter your email address.
translation: 点击右上角的“登录”，输入你的邮箱地址。

english: Open the magic link we email you. It works once and expires quickly.
translation: 打开我们发到邮箱的魔法链接。它只能使用一次，且很快过期。

english: You return to the app signed in, with nothing to remember or reset.
translation: 你会以已登录状态回到应用，无需记忆或重置任何内容。

english: Use the buttons beside Sign in to change the theme, language and text size, or to share the page.
translation: 使用“登录”旁边的按钮切换主题、语言和文字大小，或分享此页面。

english: A guided walkthrough of the plan registry: how to create a plan, run its delivery board, read its flow, take an idea all the way to a plan, and steer it through governance.
translation: 计划登记库的图文导览：如何创建计划、运行交付看板、读懂流程数据、把想法变成计划，并通过治理来推进。

english: Register a plan with a name, an optional kind label and a parent, so it sits in the one plan tree.
translation: 用名称、可选的类型标签和上级来登记计划，使其位于同一棵计划树中。

english: Open Plans and choose New (or go straight to the new-plan form).
translation: 打开“计划”并选择“新建”（或直接进入新建计划表单）。

english: Fill in Name, which is required, then pick an optional Kind, Status and Priority, and add a Code, Owner org, tags and keywords.
translation: 填写必填的“名称”，再按需选择“类型”“状态”和“优先级”，并添加“代码”、所属组织、标签和关键词。

english: Set Parent portfolio (pid) to place the plan inside another plan, and add any identifiers you already hold.
translation: 设置“上级组合 (pid)”把计划放到另一个计划之内，并添加你已有的标识符。

english: Choose Create. The plan is saved and you land on its detail page.
translation: 选择“创建”。计划随即保存，并跳转到它的详情页。

english: Find a plan and deal with duplicates
Filter the plan list, open a record, and check whether it repeats another plan before you merge it.
translation: 筛选计划列表，打开记录，并在合并前检查它是否与其他计划重复。

english: On Plans, use the grid filter to narrow the list by Name, then open a plan to see its Kind, Status, Code, Owner org, tags and identifiers.
translation: 在“计划”中用表格筛选按名称缩小范围，再打开计划查看其类型、状态、代码、所属组织、标签和标识符。

english: On the detail page choose Check duplicates. Likely matches appear under Potential duplicates with their scores.
translation: 在详情页选择“检查重复”。可能的匹配项会连同分数显示在“潜在重复”下。

english: Open the matching plan to compare the two, then use Edit to correct either record.
translation: 打开匹配的计划进行对比，然后用“编辑”修正其中任一条记录。

english: On Merge, enter the Surviving plan id and Duplicate plan id, choose Load preview, then Merge. The duplicate is soft-deleted and listed under Recent merges.
translation: 在“合并”中输入保留计划的 id 和重复计划的 id，选择“加载预览”，再点“合并”。重复项被软删除，并列在“最近合并”中。

english: Each plan has a Kanban board, with sprints and a burndown, to track its tasks.
translation: 每个计划都有带冲刺和燃尽图的看板，用来跟踪任务。

english: Open a plan and choose Board.
Enter a New task title, optional story points and a sprint, then choose Add task.
translation: 输入新任务标题、可选的故事点和冲刺，然后选择 Add task。

english: Drag a card between Todo, In progress, In review, Done and Blocked. Each drag is saved as a status change.
translation: 在 Todo、In progress、In review、Done 和 Blocked 之间拖动卡片。每次拖动都会保存为一次状态变更。

english: Under Sprints, enter a Sprint name with a start and end date and choose Add sprint. Select it to see the burndown, and use the standup, retro notes and velocity sections.
translation: 在 Sprints 下输入冲刺名称及开始、结束日期，选择 Add sprint。选中它即可查看燃尽图，并使用站会、回顾笔记和速率部分。

english: Time-based analysis shows where a plan's calendar time goes, not just how busy people are.
translation: 基于时间的分析显示计划的日历时间花在哪里，而不仅仅是大家有多忙。

english: Open a plan and choose Flow.
Read the headline tiles first: Service level expectation, Flow efficiency, First pass yield and Work in progress.
translation: 先看核心指标：Service level expectation、Flow efficiency、First pass yield 和 Work in progress。

english: Check Aging work in progress for items that have waited longer than expected, then look at Blocked and Rework.
translation: 在 Aging work in progress 中查看等待时间超出预期的事项，再看 Blocked 和 Rework。

english: Use the Cumulative flow window, the Constraints ranking and the Distributions to see what is slowing delivery. Nothing here ranks individual people.
translation: 用 Cumulative flow 时间窗、Constraints 排名和 Distributions 找出拖慢交付的原因。这里不会对任何个人排名。

english: Capture an idea, let people vote, then move it through a proposal into a real plan.
translation: 记录一个想法，让大家投票，再经由提案变成真正的计划。

english: Open Ideas and use Capture with an Idea title and a Pitch. People vote with the up arrow, and the most-voted ideas come first.
translation: 打开“想法”，用“记录”填写想法标题和简介。大家用向上箭头投票，得票最多的想法排在最前。

english: Pick a Convert target and choose To proposal. An idea nobody will act on can be dismissed instead.
translation: 选择转换目标，再点“转为提案”。没人会跟进的想法可以直接驳回。

english: Open Proposals (work intake). A draft is submitted, then reviewed, then approved or rejected. Use duplicates? to check for repeated demand.
translation: 打开“提案”（工作受理）。草稿先提交、再审阅，然后批准或拒绝。用 duplicates? 检查重复需求。

english: Choose promote on an approved proposal. It becomes a plan, and the work item link takes you to it.
translation: 在已批准的提案上选择 promote。它会变成计划，工作项链接会带你过去。

english: One panel holds a plan's gates, risks, budget, benefits, milestones and allocations.
translation: 一个面板汇集计划的关口、风险、预算、收益、里程碑和资源分配。

english: Open a plan and choose Governance.
Under Gate journey, choose a decision (approved, approved with conditions, hold or rejected) and Record decision to move to the next gate.
translation: 在“阶段关口”下选择一个决定（approved、approved_with_conditions、hold 或 rejected），点“记录决定”进入下一关口。

english: Raise a New risk and escalate it if it grows. Add Budget lines with a category and planned amount, and declare Benefits, then realize them as they arrive.
translation: 提出新风险，风险扩大时上报。添加带类别和计划金额的预算行，声明收益，并在收益到位时标记实现。

english: Add Milestones, mark them complete, and use Allocate to give people capacity. The Schedule link draws the dates and dependencies.
translation: 添加里程碑并标记完成，用 Allocate 给人员分配容量。“进度表”链接会画出日期和依赖关系。

english: Sign-in did not complete. Please try again.
Sign-in was cancelled or is not permitted by your organization.
translation: 登录已取消，或您的组织不允许登录。

english: The sign-in service cannot be reached. Please try again later.
translation: 无法访问登录服务，请稍后再试。

english: Could not move {title} to {column}; it is back where it was.
translation: 无法将 {title} 移至 {column}，已恢复到原位置。

english: Shaded columns are days off: weekends and holidays in this plan's working calendar.
translation: 阴影列为休息日：本计划工作日历中的周末和假日。
已将 {n} 个任务导出到 {file}

english: Each bar is a cost range; taller means more simulations ended there. Solid lines are P50, P80 and P90 (labelled); the dashed line is the budget.
translation: 每根柱代表一个成本区间，越高表示落在该区间的模拟次数越多。实线为 P50、P80 和 P90（已标注），虚线为预算。

english: Each plan's budget and mean simulated cost in {currency}
translation: 各计划的预算和平均模拟成本（{currency}）

english: No register risk was used as a cost event.
translation: 未将任何登记风险用作成本事件。
各条目的估算和敏感度（{currency}）

english: Seed {seed}: the same seed gives the same result. Up to {max_iterations} iterations.
translation: 种子 {seed}：相同的种子给出相同的结果。最多 {max_iterations} 次迭代。

english: The same figures as a table
cannot meet a constraint or deadline (the line marks the limit)
translation: 无法满足约束或截止日期（线条标示限制）

english: critical: any slip moves the finish
translation: 关键：任何延误都会推迟完成日期

english: No scheduled tasks to draw yet. Give a task a duration (and a start date or a predecessor).
translation: 暂无可绘制的已排期任务。请为任务设置工期（以及开始日期或前置任务）。

english: the outline under a bar is where it was baselined
translation: 条形下方的轮廓表示其基线位置

english: {from} to {to}. Float is counted in the plan's business days; bars are drawn in calendar days.
translation: {from} 至 {to}。浮动时间按本计划的工作日计算；条形按日历日绘制。

english: Task schedule with float, in the plan's business days
translation: 任务进度及浮动时间（按本计划的工作日）

english: the vertical gap above “Done” is work in progress; the horizontal gap to it is roughly the cycle time
translation: “已完成”上方的垂直间距为在制品；到它的水平间距约为周期时间
共 {total} · 进行中 {work_in_progress} · 已完成 {done}

english: The double line is the budget at completion: {money}.
Which way is good ({v}) cannot be changed: it would re-colour every past reading.
translation: “哪个方向为好”（{v}）不可更改：否则会改变所有历史读数的颜色。
没有带日期的任务可显示。

english: That range is too long for one column per {unit}; showing one per {unit2}.
translation: 该范围过长，无法每{unit}一列；改为每{unit2}一列。

english: Planned is {money}, the likely cost. Leave a field empty to clear it.
translation: 计划值为 {money}，即可能成本。留空某字段即可清除。

english: Every move is kept in the history: the old date, the new one, why, and who.
translation: 每次调整都会记入历史：原日期、新日期、原因及操作者。

english: Pick the tasks that must be done
This plan has no tasks yet.
When all those tasks are done
translation: 当这些任务全部完成时

english: No scheduled tasks to draw yet.
translation: 暂无可绘制的已排期任务。

english: Task network: boxes are tasks, arrows are dependencies
translation: 任务网络：方框为任务，箭头为依赖关系

english: The same network as a list
Currency (for example EUR, JPY or GBP)
translation: 货币（例如 EUR、JPY 或 GBP）

english: Plan search is not available right now. Commands still work.
translation: 计划搜索暂不可用，命令仍可使用。

english: Type a plan name or a command

Copy cells from a spreadsheet and paste them here: one task per line, with the columns Title, Deadline (yyyy-mm-dd) and Notes, in that order. The date becomes the task's deadline. A first line that names the columns is skipped. A row with a problem is shown with the reason and is left out.
translation: 从电子表格复制单元格并粘贴到此处：每行一个任务，列依次为标题、截止日期（yyyy-mm-dd）和备注。日期将成为任务的截止日期。若首行为列名则会跳过。有问题的行会显示原因并被排除。

english: “{value}” is not a date; write it as yyyy-mm-dd
the notes are longer than {max} characters
the title is longer than {max} characters
— it has no measurable key result yet, so it has no score (not zero).
translation: — 尚无可衡量的关键结果，因此没有得分（不是零分）。

english: Key results in more than one currency are scored separately; currencies are never converted.
translation: 以多种货币计量的关键结果分别计分；货币从不换算。

english: The baseline, metric and direction cannot be changed: progress from a moving baseline is not progress.
translation: 基线、指标和方向不可更改：基线变动下的进展不算真正的进展。

english: Who does what (RACI matrix): who is Responsible, Accountable, Consulted and Informed on each task
translation: 职责分工（RACI 矩阵）：每项任务的负责人、批准人、咨询人和知会人

english: One probability covers both effects: a risk that delays a task and adds cost strikes once and does both. Leave a part empty to leave it out.
translation: 一个概率同时适用于两种影响：既延迟任务又增加成本的风险只发生一次，且两者同时发生。留空某部分即不计入。

english: Line: planned value ({from} to {to}). ● earned value and ■ actual cost, only on days recorded ({snapshots} so far). Dashed: budget at completion, {money}.
translation: 线条：计划值（{from} 至 {to}）。● 挣值和 ■ 实际成本，仅显示已记录的日期（目前 {snapshots} 次）。虚线：完工预算，{money}。

english: S-curve: planned value over time, with recorded earned value and actual cost
translation: S 曲线：计划值随时间的变化，以及已记录的挣值和实际成本

english: The same figures as a table
Schedule variance against the baseline, in business days
translation: 相对基线的进度偏差（工作日）

english: The plan's own finish cannot be compared.
translation: 无法比较计划本身的完成日期。
无操作者的已记录操作：
{returned} 行 · {distinct_actors} 位不同操作者 · {actorless} 条无操作者

english: Claim-based, so a deadline fires exactly once even if the ticker and a manual sweep race.
translation: 基于认领机制，即使定时器与手动扫描同时运行，截止事件也只触发一次。

english: Configure a rule once; as items move across the board the platform applies it. Rules never block the move that triggered them — a failure is recorded as a failed run, not an undo.
translation: 规则只需配置一次；事项在看板上移动时，平台会自动应用。规则从不阻止触发它的移动 — 失败会记录为一次失败运行，而不会撤销操作。
斜线延伸部分：提议中，不计入

english: over capacity (solid bar: firm bookings; line: capacity in force)
translation: 超出产能（实心条：已确认预订；线条：有效产能）

english: within capacity, but committing the proposed bookings would exceed it
translation: 在产能范围内，但确认提议的预订将会超出
关口评审时效阈值：{review_days} 个日历日

english: Cost rates are finance data. You do not have access to them.
translation: 成本费率属于财务数据，你无权访问。

english: No rate yet: work by this {v} is not costed.
translation: 尚无费率：此{v}的工作不计成本。

english: Band for lines with no estimate (± %)
What all your plans together could cost, given each budget line's range and the risks that add cost. Each currency is on its own; they are never added.
translation: 根据每个预算条目的区间和会增加成本的风险，估算所有计划合计可能的成本。各货币分别计算，从不相加。

english: Go back to the default for my role
translation: 恢复为我角色的默认设置

english: How the app looks and reads. These never change what you can do.
translation: 应用的外观和阅读方式。这些设置不会改变你的操作权限。

english: Keeps the everyday pages in front (My work, Plans, Board, Calendar, Tour) and puts the rest behind a “More” link. Every page is still there and still works.
translation: 将常用页面（我的工作、计划、看板、日历、导览）放在前面，其余页面收进“更多”链接。所有页面依然存在且正常可用。

english: Sign in to keep these on your account as well as on this device.
translation: 登录后，这些设置将同时保存在你的账号和此设备上。

english: This is the default for your role: {v}.
translation: 这是你角色的默认设置：{v}。

english: Untick a section to hide it from the top bar. It stays one step away at its address, and you can show it again here. Nothing is saved until you hide one, so sections added later reach you.
translation: 取消勾选某栏目即可在顶栏中隐藏它。它仍可通过其地址访问，你也可以在此重新显示。在你隐藏栏目之前不会保存任何设置，因此日后新增的栏目会自动显示。

english: Where calendars start each week. By default it follows the language you chose; week numbers stay ISO weeks, which start on Monday.
translation: 日历中每周从哪一天开始。默认跟随您选择的语言；周数仍为 ISO 周，从星期一开始。
使用阅读障碍友好字体

english: Uses the OpenDyslexic typeface, with wider spacing between letters, words and lines.
translation: 使用 OpenDyslexic 字体，并加大字母、单词和行之间的间距。

english: This version's text is final. A change goes in the next draft.
translation: 此版本的正文已定稿。如需修改，请在下一版草稿中进行。
版本 {version} 于 {on} 时现行有效。

english: What was in force on a date
Policies and procedures. A new version is reviewed and approved before it comes into force, and a version in force never changes.
translation: 政策与程序。新版本须经审阅和批准后方可生效，且现行版本永不更改。

english: Override reason, to start anyway ({min} or more characters; recorded and audited)
translation: 覆盖理由，用于照样启动（{min} 个或更多字符；会被记录和审计）

它挤占了什么（{min} 到 {max} 个字符）

translation: {title}是外部请求：批准前请写明其取舍（{min} 个或更多字符）。

english: Refused: a proposal needs a title, an amount needs a currency, and a trade-off is at most {max} characters.
translation: 已拒绝：提案需要标题，金额需要币种，取舍最多 {max} 个字符。

english: Refused: a trade-off is {min} to {max} characters, on an external ask that is not yet decided.
translation: 已拒绝：取舍须为 {min} 到 {max} 个字符，且只适用于尚未决定的外部请求。

translation: 已拒绝：另一张计分卡已是跟踪所读取的那一张。
级别 {level}，由 {who} 于 {date} 设定。

english: Refused: only a proposal in review can be approved.
translation: 已拒绝：只有评审中的提案才能批准。

translation: 今天或未来 {days} 天内到期的未完成任务。如有未完成任务但都没有截止日期，则为未知。

translation: 没有截止日期的未完成任务：其他数字看不到的那些任务。

english: How often an update is expected
Every {min} to {max} days. Setting it restarts the clock from today, so the same cadence is not sent again. A cadence cannot be removed once it is set.
translation: 每 {min} 到 {max} 天。设置后从今天重新计时，因此相同的节奏不会再次发送。节奏一旦设置便无法移除。

translation: 没有任何更改，因此未发送任何内容。

translation: 现在预计每天一次更新；从今天开始计时。

translation: 现在预计每 {n} 天一次更新；从今天开始计时。

translation: 更新从不修改或删除。每个来源按其当前状态显示：已不存在的记录显示为不再可用，每个数字都是今天的值。

translation: 选择判断并说明正在发生的事（最多 {max} 个字符）。更新一经发布便无法修改或删除，发布更新会让节奏重新计时。

english: You may add up to {claims} claims, each a sentence of up to {chars} characters citing up to {sources} sources: the numbers below, or the plan's tasks, risks, milestones and issues. Each source is checked when the update is posted.
translation: 您最多可添加 {claims} 条论断，每条为不超过 {chars} 个字符的一句话，最多引用 {sources} 个来源：下面的数字，或计划的任务、风险、里程碑和问题。发布更新时会检查每个来源。
正在发生的事（最多 {max} 个字符）

translation: 论断 {n} 引用的计划记录

translation: 请选择正常、有风险或偏离。

translation: 请说明正在发生的事，最多 {max} 个字符。

translation: 一次更新最多包含 {claims} 条论断。

translation: 论断是一句不超过 {chars} 个字符的话。

translation: 已拒绝：某个来源可能已不再是此计划的记录。未发布任何内容；请检查论断后重新发布。

english: No plan you can read has a status update due.
translation: 您可读取的计划中没有到期的状态更新。

translation: 无法加载到期的状态更新

translation: 可能性和影响均为 {min} 到 {max} 的整数；暴露度是二者之积。缓解措施最多 {max_bytes} 字节（某些文字的字符数更少）。复核日期可以更改，但不能删除。只发送您更改的内容。

translation: 可能性和影响都必须是 {min} 到 {max} 的整数。

translation: 缓解措施超过 {max_bytes} 字节。

translation: 复核日期一经设定便不能删除；请选择另一个日期。

translation: 没有任何更改，因此未发送任何内容。

translation: 该风险已不在此计划中；已重新读取列表。

translation: 已拒绝：服务未接受该状态、评分或缓解措施。没有任何更改。

translation: 已知的第一个分数；历史从这里开始。

translation: 该问题已不在此计划中；已重新读取列表。

translation: 已拒绝：您不能删除此计划的问题。未删除任何内容。

translation: 只有管理员才能删除“{title}”：其类型的工作流控制着它的状态变更或字段。未发送任何内容。

translation: 删除问题“{title}”？它将从所有列表中消失；其记录会保留以供审计。

translation: 删除问题会将其从所有列表中移除，且无法在此撤销；审计会保留记录。在控制状态变更或字段的工作流下，只有管理员才能删除问题。

translation: 已拒绝：已由此任务提出过一个未关闭的问题。已重新读取问题。

english: Refused: an issue or risk chosen is no longer on this plan. The plan's issues and risks were read again.
translation: 已拒绝：所选的某个问题或风险已不在此计划中。已重新读取本计划的问题和风险。

translation: 已拒绝：此请求没有排程器可读取的假设编辑，因此没有预测。

translation: 已拒绝：已为此变更建立过基线，或它已不再处于批准状态。已重新读取该请求。

translation: 最多选择 {max} 个问题和 {max} 个风险。

translation: “{title}”已由另一个变更请求处理；请取消勾选。

translation: 因“{title}”建立进度基线？此变更只能建立一条基线，且无法撤销。

translation: 已因此变更建立基线版本 {version}。

english: A hammock is a summary whose dates come from the tasks of this plan it links, from the earliest start to the latest finish. It is not in the dependency network, so it never changes any task's float or the finish. A task becomes one only when it has no duration, work, constraint or dependency, and its planned start is cleared; making it a task again removes every link it has. A hammock links to a task or another hammock of this plan, not to itself, not twice and not in a loop.

Only plans you can read, at most 100,000. People references are masked unless you ask for a full export, which needs the destructive right.
translation: 仅限你能读取的计划，最多 100,000 个。除非请求完整导出，否则人员引用会被遮盖；完整导出需要破坏性权限。

english: A full export needs the destructive right.
translation: 完整导出需要破坏性权限。

english: The service refused the export: narrow the filter (at most 100,000 plans).
translation: 服务拒绝了导出：请缩小筛选范围（最多 100,000 个计划）。

english: One plan per line (JSON lines) or per row (CSV), at most 100,000 rows; the deployment caps the file's size. Sending the same file again starts nothing new.
translation: 每行一个计划（JSON 行）或每行一条（CSV），最多 100,000 行；文件大小受部署限制。再次发送同一文件不会开始新的作业。

english: A row with no identifier that looks like an existing plan
translation: 没有标识符且看起来像现有计划的行

english: The file is over the deployment's size limit.
translation: 文件超过了部署的大小限制。

english: The service refused the file: it is empty, too large or not in the format chosen.
translation: 服务拒绝了文件：文件为空、过大，或不是所选格式。

english: Started: the job is at the top of the list.
translation: 已开始：作业在列表顶部。

english: This file was already sent; its job is in the list.
translation: 此文件已发送过；其作业在列表中。

english: Rows that looked like a plan already here are held, not created. Decide each one: create it as a new plan, or discard it as a duplicate. Merging it into the plan it looks like is not offered here: discard it, then merge the plans from the plan list.
translation: 看起来像已有计划的行会被保留，不会创建。请逐一决定：作为新计划创建，或作为重复项丢弃。此处不提供合并到相似计划：请先丢弃，再从计划列表合并计划。

english: Could not load the rows held for review.
It is a duplicate: discard it
Discard “{name}”? Nothing was created from it.
translation: 丢弃“{name}”？没有从中创建任何内容。

english: That row has already been decided.
The held row is no longer a valid plan, so it cannot be created.
translation: 保留的行已不再是有效计划，因此无法创建。

english: That row is no longer there.
Showing the rows held by one import.
translation: 正在显示一次导入保留的行。

english: Everything stored about the plan, as JSON, for a records or access request. Where your access masks people, who leads and owns it is masked and the file says so. Every such export is written to the plan's audit trail.
translation: 以 JSON 提供计划的全部存储内容，用于记录或查阅请求。若你的权限会遮盖人员，负责人和所有者会被遮盖，文件中会注明。每次此类导出都会写入计划的审计记录。

english: Could not load the template's changes.
This plan was not made from a saved template, so there is nothing to bring up to date.
translation: 此计划不是由已保存的模板创建的，因此无需更新。

english: Brought up to date with version {synced}; the template is at version {version}.
translation: 已更新到版本 {synced}；模板当前为版本 {version}。

english: Each change below is the template's since this plan was last brought up to date. Tick the ones to take; the rest stay waiting. A change to a task this plan's own people have edited or removed is applied only if you also tick “Overwrite this plan's edit”.
translation: 下面每项变更都是自此计划上次更新以来模板所做的。勾选要采纳的；其余继续等待。对于此计划的人员自己编辑或删除过的任务，只有同时勾选“覆盖此计划的编辑”时才会应用其变更。

english: Up to date: there is no change this plan has not taken.
translation: 已是最新：没有此计划未采纳的变更。

english: This plan's own people have edited or removed this task.
translation: 此计划的人员已编辑或删除此任务。

english: Apply the chosen changes to this plan? Tasks are added, changed or removed as listed, and the change is recorded.
translation: 将所选变更应用到此计划？任务会按列出的内容新增、修改或删除，并记录此次变更。

english: Tick at least one change first.
translation: 请先勾选至少一项变更。

english: Of those, overwriting this plan's own edits: {n}.
translation: 其中覆盖此计划自身编辑的：{n}。

english: “{title}” was not applied: this plan has edited it; tick “Overwrite this plan's edit” to apply it anyway.
translation: “{title}”未应用：此计划已编辑过它；若仍要应用，请勾选“覆盖此计划的编辑”。

english: “{title}” was not applied: this plan removed the task, so there is nothing to change.
translation: “{title}”未应用：此计划已删除该任务，没有可修改的内容。

english: The service refused the changes: the template may have changed meanwhile. Read the changes again.
translation: 服务拒绝了变更：模板可能已在此期间更改。请重新读取变更。

english: No plan you can read was made from it.
translation: 没有你能读取的、由此模板创建的计划。

english: Could not load the plans made from it.
translation: 无法加载由此模板创建的计划。

english: The chosen plan tree's tasks become the template's next version. The tree must keep the template's shape: the same plans in the same places, with new plans only at the end. Plans made from the template are not changed; each sees the difference on its Template changes page.
translation: 所选计划树的任务将成为模板的下一个版本。计划树必须保持模板的结构：相同的计划在相同的位置，新计划只能在末尾。由模板创建的计划不会改变；每个计划都可在其“模板变更”页面看到差异。

english: Make the tasks of “{name}” the next version of “{template}”?
translation: 将“{name}”的任务作为“{template}”的下一个版本？

english: Plans in the tree you cannot read were left out: {n}.
translation: 已略过计划树中你无法读取的计划：{n}。

english: The plan tree no longer has the template's shape: a revision may change tasks and add plans at the end, not move or rename plans.
translation: 计划树已不再符合模板的结构：修订可以更改任务并在末尾添加计划，但不能移动或重命名计划。
导入多个 MS Project 文件

english: Import several MS Project files — PPM
translation: 导入多个 MS Project 文件 — PPM

english: Bring up to ten MS Project (MSPDI XML) files in at once. Each goes into a plan you choose or into a new plan. The first step is always a preview that writes nothing; the same button then imports.
translation: 一次导入最多十个 MS Project（MSPDI XML）文件。每个文件进入你选择的计划或新计划。第一步总是不写入任何内容的预览；之后同一个按钮执行导入。

english: Files (MS Project XML, at most ten)
translation: 文件（MS Project XML，最多十个）

english: Choose at least one file first.
translation: 请先选择至少一个文件。

english: New plan's name (optional: the project's name in the file)
translation: 新计划名称（可选：文件中的项目名称）
将新计划放在其下（可选）

english: Import the files now? Plans are created and tasks written as previewed. This is not one transaction: a project that fails stops the rest, and plans already created stay.
translation: 现在导入这些文件？将按预览创建计划并写入任务。这不是一个事务：某个项目失败会中止其余项目，已创建的计划会保留。

english: a new plan would be made
This project failed, so the ones after it were not attempted. Fix the file and import again: plans that exist are updated, not duplicated.
translation: 此项目失败，因此其后的项目未尝试。修正文件后再次导入：已有计划会被更新，不会重复。

english: People and resources in the files
Resources are listed once across all the files, with how many assignments each has. They are not matched to people: a name is not an identity.
translation: 资源在所有文件中只列一次，并附每个资源的分配数。资源不会与人员匹配：名称不代表身份。

english: Links between the files that would be made: {n}.
Links that point outside the files or to a missing task, not made: {n}.
translation: 指向文件之外或缺失任务的链接，未创建：{n}。

english: No links between the files were made, because a project failed.
translation: 由于某个项目失败，未创建文件之间的链接。

english: Not offered here: mapping the files' custom fields, matching resources to people and importing their rates.
translation: 此处不提供：映射文件的自定义字段、将资源与人员匹配以及导入其费率。

english: The service refused the files: one is not MS Project XML, is too large, or names a plan you cannot see.
translation: 服务拒绝了文件：其中有文件不是 MS Project XML、过大，或指定了你无法查看的计划。
导入多个 MS Project 文件

english: Components group a plan's tasks by part of the work, for example the API or the mobile app. A task belongs to at most one. Every task is counted: those in no component are listed as unassigned.
translation: 组件按工作部分对计划的任务分组，例如 API 或移动应用。一个任务最多属于一个组件。所有任务都会计入：不属于任何组件的任务列为未分配。

english: This plan has no components yet.
Remove the component “{name}”? No task belongs to it, so nothing else changes.
translation: 移除组件“{name}”？没有任务属于它，因此其他内容不会改变。

english: Tasks still belong to it: {n}. Move them to another component before removing it.
translation: 仍有任务属于它：{n}。移除前请将其移到其他组件。

english: Tasks still belong to this component. Move them to another one first.
translation: 此组件仍有任务。请先将其移到其他组件。

english: Lead (optional: a person: or worker: reference)
translation: 负责人（可选：person: 或 worker: 引用）

english: The lead must be a person: or worker: reference.
translation: 负责人必须是 person: 或 worker: 引用。

english: A component with this name already exists in the plan.
A plan holds at most 200 components.
translation: 一个计划最多有 200 个组件。

english: A person's primary role decides which row above counts their declared capacity as supply. Setting one needs the resource manager role or an administrator; anyone else sees only their own.
translation: 一个人的主要角色决定了上方哪一行把其已申报的产能计为供给。设置角色需要资源经理角色或管理员；其他人只能看到自己的。

english: No one has a primary role yet.
translation: 还没有人设置主要角色。
人员（person: 或 worker: 引用）

english: Role (up to 60 characters; blank clears it)
translation: 角色（最多 60 个字符；留空则清除）

english: The person must be a person: or worker: reference.
translation: 人员必须是 person: 或 worker: 引用。

english: Setting a role needs the resource manager role or an administrator.
translation: 设置角色需要资源经理角色或管理员。

english: {person} no longer has a primary role.
What this plan sets out to achieve, in order. A goal is known by its place in the list, so a change is refused if someone else changed the goals after this page read them.
translation: 本计划要实现的事项，按顺序排列。目标以其在列表中的位置识别，因此如果在本页读取之后有其他人更改了目标，更改会被拒绝。

english: This plan has no goals yet.
Remove the goal “{title}”? The goals after it move up one place.
translation: 移除目标“{title}”？其后的目标将上移一位。

english: The target date must be a real day.
translation: 目标日期必须是真实存在的日期。

english: Name the status, or choose another.
translation: 请为状态命名，或选择其他状态。

english: A plan holds at most 256 goals.
translation: 一个计划最多包含 256 个目标。

english: The goals changed after this page read them, so nothing was saved. They have been read again: check them, then try again.
translation: 在本页读取之后目标已更改，因此未保存任何内容。已重新读取目标：请检查后再试。

english: That goal is no longer there. The goals have been read again.
translation: 该目标已不存在。已重新读取目标。

english: Fields an administrator adds to every plan or task, each with a type its values are checked against. Values live apart from the plan, so they never affect matching.
translation: 管理员为每个计划或任务添加的字段，每个字段都有一个类型，其值据此检查。值与计划分开存放，因此从不影响匹配。

english: Could not load the custom fields.

translation: 仅适用于以下类型的计划：{kinds}

english: Withdraw the field “{label}”? Values already stored stay readable, marked as withdrawn, and no new ones can be set.
translation: 撤回字段“{label}”？已存储的值仍可读取并标记为已撤回，但不能再设置新值。

english: Key (lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter)
translation: 键（小写字母、数字和下划线，以字母开头）

english: Only for these plan kinds (optional, separated by commas)
translation: 仅适用于这些计划类型（可选，用逗号分隔）

english: Choices, one per line (up to 100, each up to 100 characters)
translation: 选项，每行一个（最多 100 个，每个最多 100 个字符）

english: Every plan or task must have a value
translation: 每个计划或任务都必须有值

english: The key must be lowercase letters, digits and underscores, start with a letter, and be at most 100 characters.
translation: 键必须由小写字母、数字和下划线组成，以字母开头，且不超过 100 个字符。

english: A label is required, at most 100 characters.
translation: 需要标签，最多 100 个字符。

english: A list field needs at least one choice.
translation: 列表字段至少需要一个选项。

english: A list holds at most 100 choices, each at most 100 characters.
translation: 列表最多 100 个选项，每个最多 100 个字符。

english: Each choice may appear only once.
translation: 每个选项只能出现一次。

english: A field with this key already exists for that kind of subject.
translation: 该类对象已有使用此键的字段。

english: There are more than 5,000 stored values for this field; only the first 5,000 were looked at.
translation: 此字段存储的值超过 5,000 个；只检查了前 5,000 个。

english: Give a value to look for.
The value must be a whole number.
The value must be a real day.
translation: 值必须是真实存在的日期。
计划的自定义字段 — PPM

english: The values of the fields an administrator declared for plans of this kind. A save sends only what changed; if one value is wrong, nothing is saved.
translation: 管理员为此类计划声明的字段的值。保存时只发送更改的内容；只要有一个值不正确，就不会保存任何内容。

english: Could not load this plan's custom fields.
translation: 无法加载此计划的自定义字段。

english: Required fields with no value yet: {fields}
No custom field applies to this plan's kind yet. Fields are declared on the page
translation: 尚无适用于此计划类型的自定义字段。字段在以下页面声明

english: Nothing changed, so nothing was sent.
translation: 没有更改，因此未发送任何内容。

english: {label}: the value must be a whole number.
{label}: the value must be a real day.
{label}: choose one of the field's choices.
translation: {label}：请从该字段的选项中选择一个。

english: {label} is required and cannot be left empty.
The checklist each onboarding or offboarding case starts from, with when each item is due from the date it takes effect. A case already started keeps its items.
translation: 每个入职或离职案例开始时使用的清单，以及每项自生效日期起的到期时间。已开始的案例保留其事项。

english: This kind uses its own checklist.
translation: 此类型使用自己的清单。

english: This kind uses the built-in checklist; its items are the service's, in English.
translation: 此类型使用内置清单；其事项来自服务，为英文。

english: Go back to the built-in checklist
Go back to the built-in checklist for “{kind}”? The custom one is removed; cases already started keep their items.
translation: 将“{kind}”恢复为内置清单？自定义清单将被删除；已开始的案例保留其事项。

english: Could not go back to the built-in checklist.
Item {n}: what to do (up to 200 characters)
translation: 第 {n} 项：要做的事（最多 200 个字符）

english: Item {n}: days from the date (−365 to 365; negative is before)
translation: 第 {n} 项：距日期的天数（−365 到 365；负数表示之前）
一个清单有 1 到 {max} 项。

english: Item {n}: a title is required, up to 200 characters.
translation: 第 {n} 项：需要标题，最多 200 个字符。

english: Item {n}: the days must be a whole number from −365 to 365.
translation: 第 {n} 项：天数必须是 −365 到 365 之间的整数。

english: Changing a checklist needs the permission to manage people.
translation: 更改清单需要管理人员的权限。

english: This plan follows version {from}; the newest is version {to}.
translation: 此计划遵循版本 {from}；最新的是版本 {to}。

english: Move this plan to version {to} of “{name}”? It follows version {from} now; the newest text then applies to it.
translation: 将此计划改为“{name}”的版本 {to}？它目前遵循版本 {from}；改用后适用最新文本。

english: A plan above this one decides which version applies; move it there.
translation: 由上级计划决定适用哪个版本；请在那里更改。

english: Make this plan follow version {n} of “{name}”? It keeps that version until it is moved.
translation: 让此计划遵循“{name}”的版本 {n}？在更改之前它会保留该版本。

english: Only the person who defined this process, or an administrator, may change or retire it.
translation: 只有定义此流程的人或管理员才能更改或停用它。

english: Nothing changed, so no version was made.
translation: 没有更改，因此未创建版本。

english: Saved “{name}” as version {v}; runs already going keep their version.
translation: 已将“{name}”保存为版本 {v}；正在进行的运行保留其版本。

english: Retire “{name}”? No new run of it can start; runs already going go on.
translation: 停用“{name}”？将无法开始新的运行；正在进行的运行会继续。

english: Saving makes a new version; runs already going keep the version they started with.
translation: 保存会创建新版本；正在进行的运行保留其开始时的版本。

english: A title is required, up to 120 characters.
translation: 需要标题，最多 120 个字符。

english: A message is required, up to 4,000 characters.
translation: 需要内容，最多 4,000 个字符。

english: A time could not be read; choose it again.
translation: 无法读取时间；请重新选择。

english: The expiry must come after the time it is published.
translation: 过期时间必须晚于发布时间。

english: One person asked to approve a plan, a task or another subject, outside any approval process. A decision is final, and a rejection says why.
translation: 在任何审批流程之外，请一个人审批某个计划、任务或其他对象。决定是最终的，拒绝须说明理由。
没有等待您处理的事项。

english: Comment (required to reject; up to 2,000 characters)
translation: 意见（拒绝时必填；最多 2,000 个字符）

english: You have not asked anyone yet.
translation: 您还没有请任何人审批。

english: Raised by an approval process: cancel its run to stop it.
translation: 由审批流程发起：取消其运行即可停止。

english: Withdraw this request? The person asked can no longer decide it.
translation: 撤回此请求？被请求的人将无法再作决定。

english: Who is asked (person: or worker: and a UUID)
translation: 请谁审批（person: 或 worker: 加 UUID）

english: The subject's id must be a UUID.
translation: 对象 ID 必须是 UUID。

english: The person asked must be person: or worker: followed by a UUID.
translation: 被请求的人必须是 person: 或 worker: 后接 UUID。

english: A note or a comment is at most 2,000 characters.
translation: 备注或意见最多 2,000 个字符。

english: A rejection must say why: write a comment.
translation: 拒绝必须说明理由：请写下意见。

english: This request was already decided or withdrawn, and a decision is final. The lists have been read again.
translation: 此请求已被决定或撤回，决定是最终的。已重新读取列表。

english: That subject or request is not there, or you may not read it.
translation: 该对象或请求不存在，或您无权查看。

english: Only the person asked may decide this request.
translation: 只有被请求的人才能决定此请求。

english: Only the person who asked may withdraw this request.
translation: 只有发起人才能撤回此请求。

english: Could not ask for the approval.
No custom field is declared for tasks yet. Fields are declared on the page
translation: 尚未为任务声明任何自定义字段。字段在以下页面声明

english: Could not load this task's custom fields.
translation: 无法加载此任务的自定义字段。

english: What this product is doing now, next and later, as its public roadmap shows it. A roadmap belongs to a plan of kind Product.
translation: 此产品现在、接下来和以后在做什么，如其公开路线图所示。路线图属于类型为 Product 的计划。

english: Only a plan of kind Product has a public roadmap. Change the plan's kind to make one.
translation: 只有类型为 Product 的计划才有公开路线图。请更改计划类型后再创建。

english: A roadmap is stale {days} days after its last review.
translation: 路线图在上次复审 {days} 天后视为过时。

english: Address (lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens, up to 64)
translation: 地址（小写字母、数字和单个连字符，最多 64 个）

english: Address (optional; made from the title when left empty)
translation: 地址（可选；留空则由标题生成）
愿景（可选，最多 2,000 个字符）

english: What the product is, for someone new to it (optional, up to 2,000 characters)
translation: 产品是什么，写给初次了解的人（可选，最多 2,000 个字符）

english: Nothing changed, so nothing was sent.
translation: 没有更改，因此未发送任何内容。

english: Remove “{title}” ({id})? Its public id is never given to another item.
translation: 移除“{title}”（{id}）？其公开 ID 永远不会给其他条目使用。

english: What the work is (optional, up to 2,000 characters)
translation: 工作内容（可选，最多 2,000 个字符）

english: What changes, and for whom (optional, up to 2,000 characters)
translation: 改变什么、对谁（可选，最多 2,000 个字符）

english: Phase, in the product's own words (optional, up to 100 characters)
translation: 阶段，用产品自己的说法（可选，最多 100 个字符）

english: Tags, separated by commas (optional; up to 20, each up to 50 characters)
translation: 标签，用逗号分隔（可选；最多 20 个，每个最多 50 个字符）

english: A title is required, up to 200 characters.
translation: 需要标题，最多 200 个字符。

english: The address must be lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens, up to 64 characters.
translation: 地址必须由小写字母、数字和单个连字符组成，最多 64 个字符。

english: A text is at most 2,000 characters.
The phase is at most 100 characters.
A tag is at most 50 characters.
Each tag may appear only once.
translation: 每个标签只能出现一次。

english: Another roadmap has or had that address; choose another.
translation: 其他路线图正在使用或曾使用该地址；请另选一个。

english: The roadmap or the item is no longer there; the page has been read again.
translation: 路线图或条目已不存在；已重新读取页面。

english: Take it off the public reader…
This changes nothing: the roadmap is already as asked.
translation: 这不会改变任何内容：路线图已是所要求的样子。

english: Someone else changed these since this page read them, so nothing can be published:
translation: 自本页读取后有人更改了这些内容，因此无法发布：

english: The service would refuse this change set:
Someone else changed the roadmap meanwhile, so nothing was published. The page has been read again.
translation: 在此期间有人更改了路线图，因此未发布任何内容。已重新读取页面。

english: Could not publish the change set.
Every product roadmap you may read, published or not, and which are due a review. Open one to change it.
translation: 您可阅读的所有产品路线图（无论是否已发布），以及需要复审的路线图。打开其中一个即可更改。
所有路线图都是最新的。

english: No roadmap yet. A Product plan makes one on its own roadmap page.
translation: 还没有路线图。Product 计划在其自己的路线图页面上创建。

english: The categories a product roadmap is filed under. A category is defined once, so renaming one renames it on every roadmap that uses it.
translation: 产品路线图归入的类别。类别只定义一次，因此重命名类别会在所有使用它的路线图上一并更名。

english: Its name in other languages, one to a line: a language code, a colon, the name (cy: Cleifion)
translation: 其他语言中的名称，每行一个：语言代码、冒号、名称（cy: Cleifion）

english: Retire “{name}”? It can no longer be chosen; a roadmap that has it keeps it.
translation: 停用“{name}”？将无法再选择它；已使用它的路线图会保留。

english: A name is required, up to 100 characters.
translation: 需要名称，最多 100 个字符。

english: Each translation starts with a language code such as cy or zh-cn, then a colon.
translation: 每条翻译以 cy 或 zh-cn 之类的语言代码开头，后接冒号。

english: Each translation is 1 to 100 characters after its colon.
translation: 每条翻译在冒号后为 1 到 100 个字符。

english: Each language may be given only once.
translation: 每种语言只能给出一次。

english: A category with that name exists already.
Changing the categories needs an administrator.
A plan that holds product plans. Its colour marks its products on the public roadmaps; any colour may be chosen, and how it reads is shown.
translation: 包含产品计划的计划。它的颜色在公开路线图上标示其产品；可选择任意颜色，并显示其可读性。

english: meets AA for body text (4.5 to 1)
translation: 达到正文 AA 标准（4.5 比 1）

english: falls short of AA for body text (4.5 to 1)
translation: 未达到正文 AA 标准（4.5 比 1）

english: White text reads better on it.
translation: 此颜色上白色文字更易读。

english: Black text reads better on it.
translation: 此颜色上黑色文字更易读。

english: Colour (# and six hexadecimal digits, such as #rrggbb)
translation: 颜色（# 加六位十六进制数，如 #rrggbb）

english: Its name in other languages, one to a line: a language code, a colon, the name (cy: Arian)
translation: 其他语言中的名称，每行一个：语言代码、冒号、名称（cy: Arian）

english: Remove the colour? Its names in other languages go with it.
translation: 移除颜色？其他语言中的名称也会一并移除。

english: Removed the colour and its translations.
Nothing changed, so nothing was sent.
translation: 没有更改，因此未发送任何内容。

english: The colour is # and six hexadecimal digits, such as #rrggbb.
translation: 颜色为 # 加六位十六进制数，如 #rrggbb。

english: The roadmap and its items in other languages, field by field. A translation is marked when its source has changed since it was made.
translation: 路线图及其条目的其他语言版本，逐个字段。原文在翻译之后发生变化时，该翻译会被标记。

english: Language code (such as cy or zh-cn)
translation: 语言代码（如 cy 或 zh-cn）

english: its source changed since: check it
translation: 原文此后已更改：请检查

english: Give a language code such as cy or zh-cn.
translation: 请输入语言代码，如 cy 或 zh-cn。

english: {field}: give as many tags as the source has, separated by commas.
translation: {field}：请给出与原文数量相同的标签，用逗号分隔。

english: {field}: a tag is at most 50 characters.
